name: move-words
description:
The phrase with the listed words moved to its start or end.

The words keep the order and the spelling of the list: «диван угловой купить» with купить,угловой → «купить угловой диван». Case and ё do not count; the first word equal to an item moves.

words: the words to move.
to: where they go: "start" or "end".

Example: semkit read --text "диван угловой купить" move-words купить,угловой write -
-> купить угловой диван
Example: semkit read --text "диван угловой купить" move-words диван --to end write -
-> угловой купить диван

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --words
options.description: the words to move. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: WORDS
arguments.description: the words to move. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list. The same as --words WORDS.
